verdict.rationale: Elastic Observability's own Cases feature lets teams track investigation details, assign tasks, and collaborate on resolutions, which covers declaring and tracking incidents. Nothing in the pack shows incident timelines, on-call schedules, or escalation policies. Forwarding alerts to third-party incident management systems is an external handoff and earns no credit. Missing for 10: incident timelines, on-call scheduling, escalation policies, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can declare and track incidents with timelines, on-call schedules, and escalation policies

citations.quote: Cases allows teams to stay aware of potential issues and track investigation details, assign tasks, and collaborate on resolutions.
